description: Submit a manufacturing quote request after the user has reviewed and explicitly approved the checklist and every displayed warning. KernelCAD staff will confirm the final itemized price. This sends the request for human review and does not charge the customer or start checkout.

accessToken.description: Guest access token returned by estimate_assembly_manufacturing; required when submitting as a guest.

assembly.description: Assembly name when the script contains multiple assemblies.

approved.description: Set true only after the user has reviewed and approved the checklist.

email.description: Contact email for the quote response.

params.description: Current CAD parameter values. Materials and sheet thickness come from the CAD design.

projectSlug.description: Saved project slug. Use this for a saved assembly.

source.description: Current kernelCAD source for an unsaved assembly.

name: request_assembly_quote
